title: Audit event
description: One line of the audit log: one hook decision (package audit, Event). Field names never change; newer versions add fields, so unknown fields are allowed. Every line CyberBoar writes has time, agent, version, decision, rule, reason and durationMs; a console requires only time and decision (docs/protocol). A line is at most 65536 bytes, no object in it has the same key twice (even in different case), a key naming a field below is spelled exactly so, and it nests at most 32 levels; JSON Schema cannot express these (audit.CheckKeys).

agent.description: The agent that asked, such as claude-code or codex.

version.description: The version of the binary that decided.

toolUseId.description: The agent's ID for this tool call.

agentId.description: The subagent's ID, when a subagent made the call.

tool.description: The agent's tool name, such as Bash or Read.

actions.description: The engine actions the tool call became.

rule.description: The rule that decided, such as files.deny or default.

reason.description: Why, in words for the developer.

policyName.description: metadata.name of the policy in force.

policySha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the policy file's bytes, for drift detection.

actionsOmitted.description: Actions left out of actions to keep the line within its size bound.

tool.description: shell, read, write, list or mcp; more may be added.

path.description: The path, for read, write and list.
